name: PluginHub
description: A plugin store inside BetterDiscord's settings - browse, install, update and remove unofficial plugins from Pharaoh2k's hub and other sources, with hash-verified downloads.
author: Pharaoh2k
features: Adds a Plugin Hub page under the BetterDiscord header in Discord's settings
Browse, search, sort and filter plugins by tag; cards show author, version, size and last update
Install, update, enable/disable and uninstall plugins without leaving Discord
Every download is verified against the index (size, SHA-256, @name, @version) before anything is written
Downloads are pinned to a specific commit, with a jsDelivr mirror as fallback
Backups of replaced files are kept and can be restored from a card's menu
Update checks on startup and on an interval, with a notification offering Update all
Optional auto-update for first-party plugins or individual plugins
NEW and UPDATED badges for plugins added or changed since your last visit
Changelog viewer using BetterDiscord's changelog modal
Additional index sources (shown as third-party) and a local-path source for development
Deep link into the hub page from the plugin's own settings
